premises.text: Many people in countries like Argentina, Brazil, and Venezuela are unbanked and lack access to credit
premises.evidence_span: most of the population in this country is unbanked and also doesn't have access to credit

premises.text: The lack of access to credit makes online payments difficult for consumers
premises.evidence_span: this makes it very difficult to pay online, but impossible to do it in the most common way to do a payment online, which is on credit

premises.text: RepioCredit allows users to pay online in installments using local currency
premises.evidence_span: With RepioCredit, our users can pay online on installments in local currency

premises.text: Users can verify their identity through a photo of their ID and a selfie
premises.evidence_span: One photo of your ID and another photo as a selfie holding that ID to verify that identity

premises.text: A scoring system is used to approve credit for users based on their information
premises.evidence_span: we build a score that helps us give credit to the user

premises.text: Users can pay for purchases at various merchant locations, including in cash
premises.evidence_span: they can use any of the 16,000 merchant locations that we have partnered with, where they can go and pay in cash

premises.text: There is a significant market for online payments in Latin America due to the unbanked population
premises.evidence_span: more than 200 million banks across Latin America, and this is a very huge global problem, with more than 2.5 billion people suffering from this

value.text: Consumers can make online purchases conveniently, even without bank accounts
value.evidence_span: this makes it very convenient for a user to start buying online

notes: Traction metrics and demo details excluded as they do not represent premises.
